list.title: Quote requests
list.description: Customers asking for a price. Answer once and they get an email.
list.emptyDescription: When a customer asks for a price from your booking page, it shows up here.

deleteForm.title: Delete this request?
deleteForm.description: The request from {name} is permanently erased, including their email, phone and message. No email is sent. You can't undo it.

quoteForm.title: Send a quote
quoteForm.description: {name} gets your price by email at {email}. You can't change it afterwards.
quoteForm.amountHint: Numbers only. No currency is stored, so mention it in your message if it matters.
quoteForm.messagePlaceholder: What's included, how long it's valid, next steps…

errors.amountInvalid: Enter a valid price, like 85 or 85.50

convertForm.title: Create a booking
convertForm.description: {name} accepted your quote. Pick when the appointment happens.
convertForm.staffHint: Leave on automatic to let the system pick someone available.

declineForm.title: Decline this request?
declineForm.description: {name} is told by email that you can't help with this. You can't undo it.
declineForm.messagePlaceholder: A short, polite note for the customer

public.title: Request a quote
public.description: Tell {business} what you need. They'll reply to your email with a price.
public.name: Full name
public.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the job: size, dates, anything that affects the price.
public.footer: No account needed. We only use your details to answer this request.

errors.unavailable: This business or service is no longer available.

success.title: Request sent
success.description: {business} will review it and reply to {email}.
success.note: You won't get a confirmation email now. You'll hear back once they answer.

state.PENDING: The business has not replied yet. You will receive an email when your quote is ready.
state.ACCEPTED: You accepted this quote. The business will be in touch to schedule it.
state.CONVERTED: This quote has been turned into a booking. Check your email for the details.
state.DECLINED: The business was unable to provide a quote for this request.
